No runner or added furniture into the circulation path.
customItems: Retain the current room-specific fitted joinery/finish design; no RH loose-furniture replacement proposed.
supportingItems: Restrained neutral artwork and warm general illumination; leave high glazing open unless privacy survey finds a real need.
purchaseNotes: Complete stair finish, secure handrail/guard and usable lighting before move-in.
Optional neutral art can be added later; keep landings and the walking route clear.
No loose RH furniture or stair runner is recommended.
rooms.renderBrief: Use current approved Mineral & Walnut image unchanged. No new RH loose furniture recommended; retain documented architecture and selected materials.
rooms.status: Current finish reference; no loose RH furniture recommended
